post.summary: Redeem one purpose/client/subject-bound handoff once; never establishes authority beyond completed proof.
post.description: Only explicit C-02 sensitive-material route. A UUID, invitation email or recovery-reset proof alone is insufficient. Check client binding/purpose/subject/authentication_version/expiry/unconsumed state and required prior authentication/MFA atomically; mode follows recorded client kind. SESSION requires completed MFA where required; TOTP_SETUP requires verified email/recent password (and existing factor for replacement); RECOVERY_CODES requires newly confirmed factor or recent required MFA. M01 synthetic/mock only; production provider remains gated. Failed delivery does not permit raw credential replay.

204.description: WEB SESSION handoff only: no body; separate access/refresh/binding HttpOnly cookies plus a client-readable server-bound CSRF cookie. All Secure/SameSite=Strict/Path=/ and no Domain.

Set-Cookie.description: Repeated headers, never comma-joined: __Host-pbssu_access, __Host-pbssu_refresh and __Host-pbssu_binding are Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; no Domain. __Host-pbssu_csrf has same restrictions except client-readable for X-CSRF-Token. No credential examples.

info.title: PBSSU Rescue Ops API
info.description: Approved documentation baseline 2026-11-07; Q-01/Q-03/Q-04/C-02 approved policy, not runtime evidence. Generic identity responses contain metadata only. Sensitive material is confined to the explicitly documented one-time credential handoff. M01 synthetic/mock mail only; no production delivery authorized.

bearerAuth.description: Native mobile short-lived JWT delivered only by completed-auth dedicated handoff; current session/assurance/membership checks always apply.

refreshCookie.name: __Host-pbssu_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Web opaque refresh request cookie; issued only by the SESSION handoff, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict/Path=/, no Domain. Never exposed through generic JSON.

challengeBinding.name: X-Auth-Challenge-Binding
challengeBinding.description: Client-supplied high-entropy nonce bound to prior first-factor/invitation challenge. Challenge ID alone is insufficient. No tenant authority.

accessCookie.name: __Host-pbssu_access
accessCookie.description: Web session access cookie issued only by the dedicated completed-auth handoff; Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, no Domain.

refreshHeader.name: X-Refresh-Token
refreshHeader.description: Native mobile refresh secret from dedicated authenticated handoff; OS-secure storage, TLS only and always redacted.

handoffBinding.name: X-Auth-Challenge-Binding
handoffBinding.description: High-entropy client binding matching completed proof/session and purpose-bound one-time handoff. Handoff ID alone grants nothing.

handoffBindingCookie.name: __Host-pbssu_binding
handoffBindingCookie.description: Established web-session binding cookie from prior dedicated redemption; Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict/Path=/, no Domain. Requires current server-bound proof plus Origin/CSRF; never suffices without handoff/purpose guards.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: Server-bound CSRF cookie echo, required with cookie authentication; trusted Origin and strict CORS also mandatory. Never logged. Applies to cookie-authenticated reads and writes for one explicit client contract.

client_binding.description: Client-generated CSPRNG >=256-bit challenge binding, held locally and never echoed.

MembershipPatch.description: Administrative deactivation only. Activation/reactivation requires fresh invitation acceptance; never PATCH ACTIVE.

Password.description: New password policy; no truncation. Compromised-password checks are server-side.

Error.description: Standard error: invalid request 400, unauthenticated 401, forbidden 403, absent/out-of-scope 404, version/idempotency conflict 409, expired sync cursor 410, invalid semantic command 422, throttled 429, retryable service failure 503.
